anomaly_label: Increased distillate flow to distillate receiver (V003)

evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~274-278 °C and rises steadily (~0.2 °C/min) with no corresponding response anywhere in the column
All column temperatures flat and static (T702 ~60.5, T712 ~36.0) for 20+ min; no boil-up front or separation profile developing
Pressure drops only ~1.3/2.0 mbar, essentially noise-level, indicating little to no vapour traffic despite the extreme reboiler reading

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature/heater duty reading and reboiler pressure to distinguish a genuine overheat from a T701 thermocouple fault; also composition sampling once column develops a profile.
